x: Jenner made the smallpox vaccine, Salk the polio vaccine, Pasteur the rabies vaccine and germ theory, and Koch worked on TB and bacteriology, giving a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i.
In active immunity the body makes its own antibodies, so it starts slowly but leaves memory cells for long protection. Ready-made or maternal antibodies are passive.
In passive immunity ready-made antibodies are given, as in antiserum or from mother to baby, so protection is fast but short-lived without memory.
Natural active immunity follows infection, artificial active follows vaccination, natural passive comes from maternal antibodies and artificial passive from antiserum, giving a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i.
t: Recall the four types of acquired immunity.

x: Three involve ready-made antibodies: passive, natural passive and artificial passive. Artificial active immunity comes from vaccination, where the body makes its own.
